verdicts.opus: A and B both grounded the fact-check in the audit. B went further: it drilled into the documents behind every claim, separated verified from unverified quotes, and gave a decisive rewrite. A had cleaner replay provenance but misreported the reference's Parkinson's/diabetes tally. C and D answered from memory; C added fabricated-looking DOIs and D had too few identifiers to check.
verdicts.gpt: D is the strongest decision aid: its figures, export, and citations trace to the supplied audit, and it explains what the retrieval counts do and do not establish. A offers more proposed next steps, but its unverified quotes and partly ungrounded interpretations weaken confidence; B and C rely on memory or estimates, and B adds unresolved identifiers and an untagged number.
